title.narrative: Tashkent Province Water Supply Development Project

description.narrative: The project will support the Government of Uzbekistan in the rehabilitation of a regional water supply system located in two districts of Tashkent Province. Responding directly to the needs of urban communities, it will upgrade existing water supply networks, provide potable water treatment services, build institutional capacity, and assist to strengthen the province's water supply and wastewater utility.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved access to reliable, sustainable, and affordable water supply services in Tashkent Province (Zangiota and Kibray Districts)

Kadirya regional water system provide 24 hours a day water supply to 58 settlements (Zangiota: 38 settlements, Kibray: 20 settlements) (baseline 2016: 12.6 hours/day) Achievement: 24 Progress/Status: In progress. Kadirya WTP is providing 24/7 water supply to 8 settlements in Kibray district. Construction in 14 settlements (New Water Supply Lines) in Zangiota and Tashkent districts are 95% completed. Data Source: EA project completion report and survey report

Public satisfaction with quality of water supply increased to 90% (baseline 2016: 46%) Achievement: 60 Progress/Status: In progress. 18 PS to be constructed to achieve this target. 14 of them are under operation. Remaining PS under construction and will be finalized by March 2026. Data Source: EA project completion report and survey report

100% of the population of 80 settlements (Zangiota: 38 settlements, Kibray: 20 settlements, Mirzo-Ulugbek: 1 settlement, Yashnabad: 8 settlements, Bektemir: 4 settlements, Sergeli: 9 settlements) connected to the Kadirya regional water supply system have access to reliable and safe water supply by 2022 (baseline 2016: 32,880 households and 159 commercial entities with irregular service) Achievement: 76 Progress/Status: Zangiota: 15 settlements Kibray: 28 settlements Tashkent: 47 settlements Kadirya WTP: Operationalized in May 2022 Zangiota Water Trunk Main: 55,25 km of 55,25 km already completed. Kadirya WTP to WDC Keles Trunk Main pipeline is under operation. Data Source: EA project completion report and survey report

Bills collection for water supply services increased to 95% (Baseline 2016: 85%) Achievement: 85 Progress/Status: Ongoing. There are 320 000 population in 3 project areas. 50 000 additional households will be installed with new water meters. Bills collection can be calculated afterwards. To reach the target it is needed to complete TPWS-W-05 contract. Data Source: EA project completion report and survey report
